sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Category product counts in wp-admin no longer drift after an import.** The import writes `_stock_status` low-level (`update_post_meta`) for speed, which never fires the term-count hook WooCommerce uses to keep `product_cat`/`product_tag` counts current — so the counts shown next to categories grew stale after every run (a category could read 1237 while actually holding 1268 in-stock products). The importer now calls WooCommerce's own `wc_recount_all_terms()` once at the end of each import, recounting all product terms with visibility taken into account, so the admin counts match the catalogue. Storefront listings were never affected (they query products directly); this only corrects the cached counters.
  • **The wp-admin menu label stays in English on localized sites.** The Russian translation rendered the sidebar menu item as «Импорт прайсов», out of step with every other MVweb plugin, whose menu labels stay English in the admin sidebar. The menu string is now left untranslated so the item reads "Price Importer" everywhere; the settings screen itself remains fully localized.
